description: Pinned core call sites of native primitives. accept.py compares the core_dependents of each listed primitive in every chunk plan (default and lowering-trace) with this list; a new or removed site rejects the run until the list and the proofs about these sites are reviewed (NATIVE_SHELL_SCOPE O14(b)).

chelis_types::native::{impl chelis_types.justification: The cancellation polling sites. Runtime/Cancellation.lean proves the polling outcome for every monotone Lean-model oracle (polling_outcome, matched_cancel_oracle_mono); a proof over the extracted pollers (O14(c)) must cover exactly these sites.
